units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: For the purpose of implementing Law of the City of Moscow of 05.09.2001 No. 38 “On Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow”:
units.label: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “For the purpose of implementing Law of the City of Moscow of…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 1. Approve:
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the Regulations on the distinctions “For Services to Moscow” and “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the distinctions “For Services to Moscow”…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the Regulations on the Prizes of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the Prizes of the City of Moscow;”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the Regulations on the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow;”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the Regulations on professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on professional honorary titles of the City…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the descriptions of the distinctions “For Services to Moscow” and “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”, the honorary badge of the City of Moscow, the breast badge “Laureate of the Prize of the City of Moscow” and the breast badge accompanying professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the descriptions of the distinctions “For Services to Moscow”…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the specimens of certificates accompanying the distinctions of the City of Moscow, the Honorary Badge “Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow”, the Honorary Badge “Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow”, the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow” and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, and the forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow and the diploma accompanying the Prizes of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the specimens of certificates accompanying the distinctions…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the award nomination form for nomination for awards and conferment of professional honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the award nomination form for nomination for awards and…”

units.text: - the Instructions on the Procedure for Granting Awards and Conferring Professional Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Instructions on the Procedure for Granting Awards and…”

units.text: - the Regulations on the Commission for Awards and Honorary Titles of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the Commission for Awards and Honorary…”

units.text: - the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Teacher of the City of Moscow”;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Teacher of…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Physician of the City of Moscow”;
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Physician of…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: - the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow”.
units.label: Point 1 · “- the Regulations on the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist…”

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 2. Establish that the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow, on the basis of requests from the Human Resources Policy Directorate of the Government of Moscow, shall arrange for the manufacture and delivery of distinctions, honorary badges, breast badges accompanying prizes and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, certificate forms accompanying distinctions, honorary badges and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, diploma forms for the Prizes of the City of Moscow, forms of the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow, folders, moulded frames and cases.
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 3. Cash awards to citizens who have been awarded a distinction of the City of Moscow or the Honorary Badge “Honoured Industrialist of the City of Moscow”, conferred a professional honorary title of the City of Moscow, awarded the “Legend of the Century” Prize or granted the Commendation of the Mayor of Moscow shall be financed from the budget appropriations allocated to the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow for those purposes by the Law of the City of Moscow on the Budget of the City of Moscow for the relevant financial year and planning period.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 4. The Department of Culture of the City of Moscow, the Department of Health of the City of Moscow, the Department of Education and Science of the City of Moscow, the Department of Sport of the City of Moscow, the Tourism Committee of the City of Moscow, the Department of Regional Security and Combating Corruption of the City of Moscow, the Department of Mass Media and Advertising of the City of Moscow, the Department of Labour and Social Protection of the Population of the City of Moscow and the Department of Urban Planning Policy of the City of Moscow shall pay the Prizes of the City of Moscow in the numbers and amounts established by the Regulations on the Prizes from budget appropriations provided for those purposes by the Law of the City of Moscow on the Budget of the City of Moscow for the relevant financial year and planning period.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 5. Repealed. — Decree of the Mayor of Moscow of 27.08.2012 No. 52-УМ.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 6. Repeal the legal acts of the Mayor of Moscow in accordance with the list.
units.label: Point 6

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: 7. Assign oversight of the implementation of this Decree to N.A. Sergunina, Deputy Mayor of Moscow in the Government of Moscow and Head of the Executive Office of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
units.label: Point 7

units.locator: “ON AWARDS AND HONORARY TITLES OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: Mayor of Moscow Yu.M. Luzhkov
units.label: Point 7 · “Mayor of Moscow Yu.M. Luzhkov”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: The distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall be awarded:
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “The distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall be awarded:”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: - for major personal achievements in state, scientific, creative, industrial and other activities and for carrying out specific activities beneficial to the city that contribute to Moscow’s socioeconomic, scientific, technological and cultural development and improve the living standards of its residents;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “- for major personal achievements in state, scientific,…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: - for a substantial contribution to strengthening friendship and cooperation among nations and ethnic groups, fruitful activities to bring their cultures closer together and mutually enrich them, and active assistance in developing mutually beneficial cooperation with constituent entities of the Russian Federation and friendly relations with foreign states;
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “- for a substantial contribution to strengthening friendship…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: - for multifaceted charitable activities in the interests of the city and Muscovites.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “- for multifaceted charitable activities in the interests of…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: Persons nominated for the distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall, as a rule, have received awards or honorary titles of the City of Moscow or have been awarded state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR for services to Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “Persons nominated for the distinction “For Services to Moscow”…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: Persons awarded the distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “Persons awarded the distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW”
units.text: The distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall not be awarded more than once to the same person.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR SERVICES TO MOSCOW” · “The distinction “For Services to Moscow” shall not be awarded…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: The distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow” shall be awarded for a specific contribution to Moscow’s development and many years of fruitful activity aimed at the prosperity of the city and improvement of the well-being of Muscovites.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “The distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: Where they have rendered meritorious service, persons who have worked impeccably in organizations and institutions of the City of Moscow for 20, 25, 30, 40 or 50 years respectively and have received awards or honorary titles of the City of Moscow, or have been awarded state awards of the Russian Federation or the USSR or departmental distinctions for labour for services to Moscow, shall be nominated for the distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow”.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “Where they have rendered meritorious service, persons who have…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW”
units.text: Persons awarded the distinction “For Impeccable Service to the City of Moscow” shall receive a cash award in an amount established by the Government of Moscow. The cash award shall be paid by the Administrative Affairs Directorate of the Mayor and Government of Moscow.
units.label: REGULATIONS ON THE DISTINCTION “FOR IMPECCABLE SERVICE TO THE CITY OF MOSCOW” · “Persons awarded the distinction “For Impeccable Service to the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 1. The Prize of the City of Moscow in Literature and the Arts (hereinafter, the Prize) shall be awarded for the creation of the most talented literary and artistic works distinguished by novelty and originality that have received public recognition and contribute to the development of literature and the arts in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 1

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 2. Up to 12 Prizes, each of 2000 thousand roubles, shall be awarded annually on the eve of City Day in the following categories:
units.label: Point 2

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: - design;
units.label: Point 2 · “- design;”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: - paragraph deleted. — Decree of the Mayor of Moscow of 20.01.2010 No. 3-УМ;
units.label: Point 2 · “- paragraph deleted. — Decree of the Mayor of Moscow of…”

units.text: - visual arts;
units.label: Point 2 · “- visual arts;”

units.text: - art studies;
units.label: Point 2 · “- art studies;”

units.text: - cinema;
units.label: Point 2 · “- cinema;”

units.text: - literature;

units.text: - music;

units.text: - works for children and young people;
units.label: Point 2 · “- works for children and young people;”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: - public education activities;
units.label: Point 2 · “- public education activities;”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: - theatre;
units.label: Point 2 · “- theatre;”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: - choreography;
units.label: Point 2 · “- choreography;”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: - circus and variety arts.
units.label: Point 2 · “- circus and variety arts.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 3. Literary and artistic works and other projects shall be submitted for the Prize to the Department of Culture of the City of Moscow by institutions, creative unions and the collectives of creative organizations and associations.
units.label: Point 3

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: The Department of Culture of the City of Moscow shall accept projects and works submitted for the Prize annually from 01.12 of the preceding year to 01.03 of the current year, provided that they were made public at least one year before the closing date for submissions.
units.label: Point 3 · “The Department of Culture of the City of Moscow shall accept…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 4. The Prize may be awarded to an author or a team of authors for creating a joint project or work.
units.label: Point 4

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: The Prize need not be awarded in individual categories.
units.label: Point 4 · “The Prize need not be awarded in individual categories.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: Two or more Prizes may be awarded in one category.
units.label: Point 4 · “Two or more Prizes may be awarded in one category.”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: In the categories “visual arts”, “music”, “theatre” and “circus and variety arts”, one Prize may be awarded to several nominees for works in different areas.
units.label: Point 4 · “In the categories “visual arts”, “music”, “theatre” and “circus…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: The same author may not be nominated simultaneously for the Prize for two or more works or projects.
units.label: Point 4 · “The same author may not be nominated simultaneously for the…”

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: 5. A team nominated for the Prize must include only those authors whose contribution to the creation of the project or work was decisive.
units.label: Point 5

units.locator: REGULATIONS ON THE PRIZE OF THE CITY OF MOSCOW IN LITERATURE AND THE ARTS
units.text: A team of authors must not comprise more than five persons.
units.label: Point 5 · “A team of authors must not comprise more than five persons.”
